why: `*` is every class, and a predicate over `*` is not. `claim_tag` is declared by `concept` and not by `note`, so the step narrows to `concept` and says which class it skipped. A server that tests the predicate against every class instead answers the same node here and reports no narrowing — identical results, and the caller cannot tell that a class was silently excluded on a property it never declared. The narrowing is `info` and not `warn`: nothing is wrong, something was decided.
